items.title: Creality mBox: Slicer Update Reveals Compact 3D Printer for Families
items.originalText: Creality appears to be working on a small 3D printer for families. Version 7.3.0.6141 of Creality Print shows a previously unknown device called Creality mBox in the printer selection. The image shows a white, cube-shaped enclosure with a solid front panel, a viewing window and a handle; a small display sits in the upper right. Build volume 153 x 153 x 153. No specs, price or release date are provided. The companion app Creality Park was released on August 14, 2026 as v1.0.0 on Google Play (Android 7.0+, PEGI 3, 100+ downloads).
